# AutoBlogger - Frequently Asked Questions
**Version:** 0.1.0

## General Questions
**What is AutoBlogger?**
An AI-powered content engine that generates SEO-optimized blog posts and schedules them across multiple platforms.


**Who is this product for?**
This product is designed for users within the SaaS space.

## Billing & Access
**How is this product billed?**
Billing is managed via Stripe.

**How do I get access?**
Access is granted via the autoblogger_access entitlement.

## Support
**What level of support do I receive?**
Your subscription includes Standard support.
